backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend with user profiles, posts, stories, studies, messaging, follows, admin controls, and blob storage integration. Includes access control, user verification, teacher badges, and various social features.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two features: removal of ProfileSetupModal component and removal of profile completion status logic, both with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration files describing their functionality and relationships.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements like backgrounds, borders, and semantic tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tags and title 'Santal Connect: culture-first social photo sharing + messaging app'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component with TanStack Router setup, Internet Identity authentication gating, and route definitions for all pages including feed, messages, profiles, admin, and content creation.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAllUs: Admin panel component displaying a placeholder message indicating user listing functionality is unavailable, directing admins to use search instead.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUserC: Admin panel component for viewing read-only conversation history of a specific user, showing conversation list and individual message threads with navigation.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUserM: Admin panel component for moderating individual users, allowing admins to toggle verification status, grant/revoke teacher badges, and ban/unban users with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUsers: Main admin users management interface with tabs for searching users by display name and viewing all users, with drill-down to moderation and conversation panels for selected users.
frontend/src/components/admin/RequireAdm: Higher-order component that checks if the current user has admin privileges and displays an access denied message if not, with loading state handling.
Login page component that handles Internet Identity authentication with branded UI, background pattern, error handling, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/common/TeacherBa: Reusable badge component displaying a red circular icon with a book symbol to indicate teacher status.
frontend/src/components/common/VerifiedA: Avatar component with optional verified and teacher badge overlays positioned at bottom-right and top-right corners respectively.
frontend/src/components/common/VerifiedB: Reusable badge component displaying a blue circular icon with a checkmark to indicate verified status.
frontend/src/components/events/EventForm: Form component for creating events with fields for name, date/time, location, and description, including validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/feed/UserSearchR: Panel component displaying user search results with loading, error, and empty states, allowing navigation to user profiles from search results.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout component with sticky header (logo, app name, add story button, profile menu, logout), main content area, bottom navigation for mobile, and footer with branding and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile with icons and labels for Feed, Reels, Messages, Explore, Learn, Events, and conditionally Admin (if user is admin), highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/learn/DailyItemC: Card component displaying a daily word with title and content, styled with gradient background and sparkles icon.
frontend/src/components/learn/LearnCreat: Dialog for admins to create new lessons with title and content fields, using mutation hook to add lessons and displaying toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/components/messages/Sticker: Displays a sticker by ID using CSS sprite positioning from a sticker sheet image, with configurable size (sm/md/lg).
Popover component with a grid of stickers from a sprite sheet, allowing users to select and send stickers via callback.
frontend/src/components/posts/CommentsPa: Displays a scrollable list of comments with author avatars and names, plus a form to add new comments with textarea and send button.
frontend/src/components/posts/PostCard.t: Card component displaying a social media post with author info (avatar, name, verified/teacher badges), media (image/video), content text, like/comment buttons, and expandable comments panel.
frontend/src/components/posts/UnicodeTex: Simple wrapper component that renders text with proper whitespace and word-breaking for Unicode content.
frontend/src/components/profile/AvatarUp: Avatar upload component with file picker, image validation (type and 5MB size limit), upload progress tracking, and preview using Avatar component with fallback initials.
frontend/src/components/profile/CountryC: A dropdown select component for choosing country calling codes, pre-populated with 29 common country codes including India, US, UK, and others.
frontend/src/components/profile/Follower: A dialog component that displays a scrollable list of followers or following users with avatars and display names, allowing navigation to user profiles on click.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: A dropdown menu component showing the current user's avatar and display name with options to view/edit profile and navigate to followers/following lists.
frontend/src/components/stories/AddStory: A dialog for creating 24-hour stories with image upload, preview, progress tracking, and authentication checks using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/components/stories/StoriesR: A horizontal scrollable row displaying story circles grouped by author, with the current user's 'Add Story' button first, followed by followed users' stories.
frontend/src/components/stories/StoryVie: A full-screen dialog for viewing stories with tap navigation, progress indicators, author info with verified badge, and support for image/video media types.
frontend/src/config/brand.ts: Centralized branding configuration exporting app name ('Santal Connect'), alternate name, tagline, and description as constants.
frontend/src/config/featuredCreators.ts: Configuration for featured creator principals with an empty allowlist array and helper function to check if a principal is featured.
frontend/src/config/highlights.ts: Defines four curated highlight channels (Festivals, Folklore, Dance & Music, Art & Nature) with IDs, descriptions, and emoji icons for Santal cultural content.
frontend/src/config/stickers.ts: Defines six culturally-themed stickers (Banam, Leaf, Bird, Flower, Sacred Grove, Drum) with sprite sheet positions for messaging features.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Comprehensive collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, posts, conversations, lessons, events, stories, and admin operations with error handling and caching.
frontend/src/hooks/useReelsAutoplay.ts: React hook using IntersectionObserver to track which reel is currently visible in a scrollable container, returning the active index for autoplay functionality.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom earth-tone color palette defined as CSS variables for light and dark modes, including support for Unicode fonts like Ol Chiki.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabs for managing events, lessons, channel assignments, and users, requiring admin authentication and providing forms for creating content.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelPage.tsx: Displays posts for a specific highlight channel with navigation, channel metadata, and authenticated users can create new posts in the channel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Chat interface page that displays a conversation with another user, supports text messages and sticker selection, and includes real-time message scrolling and user profile display.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Post creation page that allows users to upload images/videos with captions, optionally assign posts to highlight channels, and create event-associated posts with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/CreateReelsPage.tsx: Dedicated page for creating video reels with caption support, video file validation (max 100MB), and upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailsPage.tsx: Event details page displaying event information (date, location, description) and associated posts, with the ability for authenticated users to create event-specific posts.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Events listing page showing all community events with upcoming/past status indicators, and admin functionality to create new events via a dialog form.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Main feed page displaying posts, stories, and user search functionality. Includes authenticated actions like creating posts/reels and viewing stories.
frontend/src/pages/HighlightsPage.tsx: Displays curated community highlight channels celebrating Santal culture with navigation to individual channels and a local talent showcase.
frontend/src/pages/LearnPage.tsx: Learning corner for Ol Chiki/Santali language featuring daily items and mini lessons. Admins and users with teacher badges can create content.
frontend/src/pages/LessonPage.tsx: Individual lesson detail page displaying title, content, and optional media with Unicode text support for Santali script.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Messages page placeholder showing empty state with prompt to start conversations from user profiles. Requires authentication.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileEditPage.tsx: Profile editing interface with form validation for display name, phone, location, and avatar upload. Includes admin-specific avatar application feature.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page displaying public/private info, posts, followers/following counts, and follow/message actions. Supports deep-linking to followers/following dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReelsPage.tsx: Displays a vertical scrolling feed of video posts (reels) with autoplay functionality, mute toggle, author info, and engagement stats (likes/comments).
frontend/src/pages/ShowcasePage.tsx: Shows a grid of featured creators from the Santal community, filtering posts by featured creator status and displaying them as clickable cards.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Normalizes backend error messages into user-friendly English text, handling common patterns like unauthorized access, profile requirements, and follow/like states.
frontend/src/utils/phoneValidation.ts: Validates and normalizes phone numbers, checking for digit-only content and length constraints (7-15 digits).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, container settings, animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata indicating removal of Internet Identity authentication and ProfileSetupModal component to enable public access without profile completion requirements.
